entities.name: Thura Sail-Rend
entities.description: A human warrior of the Beskir clan who avenged her family, died, and now feasts in Starnheim.

entities.name: Kinkiller
entities.description: Thura's former brother and ally who betrayed her and was slain by her in a duel.

entities.name: Beskir
entities.description: The clan Thura belonged to in life.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The realm of the honored dead where heroic spirits feast.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: Beings who claimed Thura's soul after her death.

entities.name: Vígniút
entities.description: A heroic spirit who drinks and trades tales with Thura.

entities.name: Gæller No-breath
entities.description: A heroic spirit who drinks and trades tales with Thura.

events.summary: Betrayed by her kin and poisoned in battle, Thura duels her traitorous brother Kinkiller.
events.quote: Thura confronted her former brother and ally turned traitor and enemy

events.summary: Thura triumphs using Kinkiller's blade against him, avenging her family and sealing her death.
events.quote: Ultimately, Thura triumphed, avenging her family's honor

events.summary: The Valkyries claim Thura's soul and confer her titles; she enters Starnheim.
events.quote: Thura's soul was claimed by the Valkyries

events.summary: Thura feasts, banters and drinks with Vígniút, Gæller No-breath and others in Starnheim.
events.quote: sharing drinks and tales with Vígniút, Gæller No-breath, and others

relations.note: Of the Beskir clan in life.
relations.quote: In life, Thura was of the Beskir clan.

relations.note: Killed him with his own blade.
